description: The site's arrangement of the desk dock: which modules it lists first, and which of them are hidden for everyone. Curated by a Workspace Manager; a user's own `User.dock_modules` is applied on top of it. A module this list never names keeps its default order and follows the ones it does, which is what stops a newly installed app's module from vanishing on a site that has already ordered its dock.

fields.description: Ordered modules for the whole site. Order is the row order; a hidden row hides that module from everyone who has not un-hidden it for themselves.
fields.label: Modules

name: Dock Order
